- generic: The pot is way too big. A pot that size requires a lot of soil which means it takes a long time to dry out. This leaves the roots sitting in wet soil suffocating and rotting. I suggest you repot in a smaller pot. The pot size needs to be based on the size of the root mass and not the size of the foliage. The pot should be no more than 2” bigger than the root mass.
